        local spawnPointsKV    = waveData["SpawnPoints"] or {}

        local orderedTemplates =
            BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, waveData)

        local maxAlive         = tonumber(waveData["MaxAlive"]) or 99999

        local monstersOrdered  = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(orderedTemplates) do
            local countStr = monstersKV[name]
            table.insert(monstersOrdered, {
                template = name,
                count    = tonumber(countStr) or 0
            })
        end

        local perTemplatePoints = BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)

        local rawBuff = waveData["Buff"] or {}
        local buffArr = {}
        for field, str in pairs(rawBuff) do
            buffArr[field] = ParseArray(str)
        end

        local intervalArr = ParseArray(waveData["SpawnInterval"])
        if #intervalArr == 0 then intervalArr[1] = 1 end

        local function BuildWaveBuff(template)
            local idx = 1
            for i, d in ipairs(monstersOrdered) do
                if d.template == template then
                    idx = i
                    break
                end
            end

            local b = {}
            for k, arr in pairs(buffArr) do
                b[k] = arr[idx] or arr[#arr] or 0
            end

            return self:ParseBuffKV(b)
        end

        local total = 0
        for _, d in ipairs(monstersOrdered) do
            local template = d.template
            local count    = d.count
            local pts      = perTemplatePoints[template] or {}
            total          = total + count * #pts
        end

        local run_type = isBoss and "boss" or "wave"
        local rid = self:CreateRun(run_type, self.current_wave_index, total)

        local tag_index = isBoss and self.current_wave_index or self.current_wave_display
        local wave_tag = string.format("%s_%s", run_type, tostring(tag_index))

        for i, d in ipairs(monstersOrdered) do
            local template    = d.template
            local count       = d.count
            local interval    = intervalArr[i] or intervalArr[#intervalArr] or 1

            local subMonsters = {
                [template] = tostring(count)
            }

            local items
            if waveData.Item then
                local item_cfg = waveData.Item[template]
                if item_cfg then
                    items = ParseStringArray(item_cfg)
                end

                -- print("[Monster Item]",template, waveData, waveData.Item, waveData.Item[template], items)
                -- DeepPrintTable(items)
            end

            local timer_id = self:CreateManagedTimer(0, function()
                if interval < 0 then
                    self:SpawnGroupRandomPoint(subMonsters, perTemplatePoints[template], {
                        max_alive          = maxAlive,
                        buff_builder       = BuildWaveBuff,
                        run_id             = rid,
                        tag                = wave_tag,
                        items              = items,
                        is_boss            = isBoss,
                        boss_segment_value = bossSegmentValue,
                    })
                else
                    local loop_id = self:CreateManagedTimer(0, function()
                        if not self.wave_active then return nil end
                        if maxAlive
                            and rid
                            and self:GetRunAliveCount(rid) >= maxAlive then
                            return interval
                        end

                        -- print("Spawning wave monsters:", template)

                        self:SpawnGroupRandomPoint(subMonsters, perTemplatePoints[template], {
                            max_alive          = maxAlive,
                            buff_builder       = BuildWaveBuff,
                            run_id             = rid,
                            tag                = wave_tag,
                            items              = items,
                            is_boss            = isBoss,
                            boss_segment_value = bossSegmentValue,
                        })

                        return interval
                    end)

                    table.insert(self.current_wave_timers, loop_id)

                    return nil
                end
            end)

            table.insert(self.current_wave_timers, timer_id)
        end
    end)

    table.insert(self.current_wave_timers, pre_timer_id)

    local end_timer_id = self:CreateManagedTimer(pre + duration, function()
        local rid = nil
        for id, run in pairs(self.runs) do
            if run.id == wave_index_snapshot then
                rid = id
                break
            end
        end

        if rid then
            local run = self.runs[rid]
            run.time_completed = true

            if run.type == "wave" and run.alive <= 0 and not run.reward_given then
                run.reward_given = true
                self:OnRunCompleted("wave", run.id)
            end

            self.runs[rid] = nil
        end

        self:StartNextWave(false)
    end)
    self.current_wave_end_timer = end_timer_id
    table.insert(self.current_wave_timers, end_timer_id)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 挑战触发
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:TriggerChallenge(id)
    local idx = tonumber(id) or id

    if idx == 1 then
        return
    end

    local data = ChallengeKV[tostring(idx)]
    if not data then
        print("[Challenge] TriggerChallenge: no data for id =", idx)
        return
    end
    self.challenge_state[idx] = self.challenge_state[idx] or { count = 0, nextAvailable = 0 }
    local st                  = self.challenge_state[idx]
    local now                 = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    local cd                  = tonumber(data["Cooldown"]) or 30
    if now < st.nextAvailable then
        print("[Challenge] id", idx, "still on cd, left =", st.nextAvailable - now)
        return
    end

    -- 递增难度次数
    st.count = st.count + 1

    -- 难度因子
    local factors = {}
    for f in string.gmatch(tostring(data["DifficultyFactors"] or "1"), "%S+") do
        table.insert(factors, tonumber(f))
    end
    if #factors == 0 then table.insert(factors, 1) end

    local factor = factors[st.count] or factors[#factors]

    -- 字段
    local affected_fields = {}
    for f in string.gmatch(tostring(data["AffectFields"] or ""), "%S+") do
        table.insert(affected_fields, f)
    end

    -- 计算下一次冷却时间
    st.nextAvailable = now + cd

    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("challenge_waves", tostring(idx), {
        cooldown = cd,
        next_cd  = st.nextAvailable,
        count    = st.count,
    })

    local function BuildChallengeBuff()
        local buff = {}
        for _, field_name in ipairs(affected_fields) do
            buff[field_name] = factor
        end

        return buff
    end

    print(string.format("[Challenge] Trigger id=%s, count=%d, factor=%.2f, cd=%d",
        tostring(idx), st.count, factor, cd))

    self:SpawnChallenge(idx, BuildChallengeBuff)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 挑战刷怪（使用 SpawnGroup + run）
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:SpawnChallenge(id, buff_builder)
    local data = ChallengeKV[tostring(id)]
    if not data then return end

    local monstersKV        = data["Monsters"] or {}
    local spawnPointsKV     = data["SpawnPoints"] or {}

    local orderedTemplates  =
        BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, data)
    local perTemplatePoints = BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)

    local total             = 0
    for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates) do
        local count = tonumber(monstersKV[template]) or 0
        local pts   = perTemplatePoints[template] or {}
        total       = total + count * #pts
    end

    local rid = self:CreateRun("challenge", id, total)

    local challenge_state = self.challenge_state[id]
    local count = challenge_state and challenge_state.count or 1
    local challenge_tag = string.format("challenge_%s_%d", tostring(id), count)

    for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates) do
        local count = tonumber(monstersKV[template]) or 0
        local pts   = perTemplatePoints[template]

        if count > 0 and pts and #pts > 0 then
            self:SpawnGroupRandomPoint({ [template] = tostring(count) }, pts, {
                copies_per_point = 1,
                buff_builder     = buff_builder,
                run_id           = rid,
                tag              = challenge_tag,
            })
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 挑战奖励
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:GiveChallengeReward(id)
    local data = ChallengeKV[tostring(id)]
    if not data then return end

    local st = self.challenge_state[id]
    local count = st and st.count or 1

    local base = data["Reward"] or {}
    local reward = {}

    if base.gold and base.gold ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.gold)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["gold"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    if base.exp and base.exp ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.exp)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["exp"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    if base.shop1_item and base.shop1_item ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.shop1_item)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["shop1_item"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    if base.shop2_item and base.shop2_item ~= "" then
        local array = ParseArray(base.shop2_item)
        if array and #array > 0 then
            reward["shop2_item"] = array[math.min(count, #array)]
        end
    end

    reward["special_selection"] = tonumber(base.special_selection) or 0

    self:GiveRewardToPlayer(reward)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boss 奖励
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:GiveBossReward(waveIdx)
    local data = WavesKV[tostring(waveIdx)]
    if not data then return end
    local reward = data["Reward"] or {}
    self:GiveRewardToPlayer(reward)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Wave 奖励
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:GiveWaveReward(waveIdx)
    local data = WavesKV[tostring(waveIdx)]
    if not data then return end
    local reward = data["Reward"] or {}
    self:GiveRewardToPlayer(reward)
end

function spawn_manager:GiveRewardToPlayer(reward)
    reward                  = reward or {}
    local gold              = tonumber(reward["gold"]) or 0
    local exp               = tonumber(reward["exp"]) or 0
    local shop1_item        = reward["shop1_item"] or 0
    local shop2_item        = reward["shop2_item"] or 0
    local special_selection = reward["special_selection"] or 0
    local player            = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)

    if not player then return end

    if gold > 0 then
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(self.pid, "gold", gold)
    end

    local unit = player:GetAssignedHero()

    if unit and exp > 0 then
        unit:AddExperience(exp, DOTA_ModifyXP_Unspecified, false, true)
    end

    if unit and shop1_item ~= 0 then
        Shop1Managers[self.pid]:AddItemRandomly(unit, shop1_item)
    end

    if unit and shop2_item ~= 0 then
        Shop2Manager:AddAbilityRandomly(unit, shop2_item)
    end

    if unit and special_selection == 1 then
        SelectionSpecial:StartSelection(self.pid)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 统一死亡监听（Boss / Wave / Challenge）
--------------------------------------------------------------------
function spawn_manager:OnUnitKilled(unit)
    local pid = unit.owner_id
    local entid = unit:GetEntityIndex()
    if pid and entid then
        SpawnManagers[pid].active_monsters[entid] = nil
    end

    local rid = unit._run_id
    if not rid then return end

    local run = self.runs[rid]
    if not run then return end

    run.alive = run.alive - 1

    -- Wave 是时间 + 怪物清空 两者都满足才完成
    if run.type == "wave" then
        if run.time_completed and run.alive <= 0 then
            self:OnRunCompleted("wave", run.id)
            self.runs[rid] = nil
        end
        return
    end

    -- Boss / Challenge ：怪全死即完成
    if run.alive <= 0 then
        -- print("Run", run.type, run.alive)
        self:OnRunCompleted(run.type, run.id)
        self.runs[rid] = nil
    end
end

**Analyzing stat keys usage**

The base buff only applies numeric keys present in MonsterStats.Calculate, which uses *_Flat/_Pct forms, but monster_stats.txt sets "RepulseResistance" without _Flat, so it gets ignored; this likely causes the buff not to apply. Next, I'll decide whether to update the config to use *_Flat or modify parsing to map direct names correctly.

**Proposing config application plan**

The current config uses direct field names like "RepulseResistance" that the parsing ignores since only *_Flat/_Pct keys in MonsterStats.Calculate are processed; to apply these buffs, either config should use *_Flat or parsing must be updated to accept direct keys. For repulse resistance, I suggest a helper function to adjust knockback distance based on MonsterStats value applied before knockback modifiers in relevant abilities. For control immunity after CC, propose implementing a hidden modifier granting debuff immunity enforced via ModifierFilter, tracking immunity duration per unit. Key clarifying questions include whether to support both naming styles, which control modifiers count as CC, when immunity starts and refreshes, and whether repulse resistance should affect knockback duration or height. This outlines areas to update and questions to raise for applying these config fields robustly.

**Planning control immunity timing**

Decided to track the first applied control's end time to schedule a single timer that clears all control modifiers and starts immunity, ignoring later controls applied before that timer fires; this aligns with the example and uses ModifierFilter's duration key.

**Defining hard control list and immunity purge**

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/data/monster_stats.lua
@@
 function MonsterStats:Clear()
     MonsterStats.cache = {}
 end
+
+function MonsterStats:GetRepulseResistance(unit)
+    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
+        return 0
+    end
+    local tag = unit._monster_buff_tag
+    if not tag or tag == "" then
+        return 0
+    end
+    local final = self:GetFinal(tag)
+    if not final then
+        return 0
+    end
+    return tonumber(final.RepulseResistance) or 0
+end
+
+function MonsterStats:CalcRepulseDistance(unit, base_distance)
+    local dist = tonumber(base_distance) or 0
+    if dist <= 0 then
+        return dist
+    end
+    local res = self:GetRepulseResistance(unit)
+    if res <= 0 then
+        return dist
+    end
+    local ratio = 1 - (res / 10000)
+    if ratio < 0 then
+        ratio = 0
+    end
+    return dist * ratio
+end
*** End Patch

+							return nil
+						end)
+					end
+				end
+			end
+		end
+	end
+
+	return true
 end

如需把这个“忽略抗性”也用于其他关键机制，告诉我对应调用点即可。

-- This is the primary barebones gamemode script and should be used to assist in initializing your game mode
BAREBONES_VERSION = "2.1.1"

-- Selection library (by Noya) provides player selection inspection and management from server lua
require('libraries/selection')

-- settings.lua is where you can specify many different properties for your game mode and is one of the core barebones files.
require('settings')
-- events.lua is where you can specify the actions to be taken when any event occurs and is one of the core barebones files.
require('events')
-- filters.lua
require('filters')

require('custom_game_mode')
local PrecacheManager = require('precache')

if USE_CUSTOM_ROSHAN then
	require('components/roshan/init')
end

--[[
  This function should be used to set up Async precache calls at the beginning of the gameplay.

  In this function, place all of your PrecacheItemByNameAsync and PrecacheUnitByNameAsync.  These calls will be made
  after all players have loaded in, but before they have selected their heroes. PrecacheItemByNameAsync can also
  be used to precache dynamically-added datadriven abilities instead of items.  PrecacheUnitByNameAsync will
  precache the precache{} block statement of the unit and all precache{} block statements for every Ability#
  defined on the unit.

  This function should only be called once.  If you want to/need to precache more items/abilities/units at a later
  time, you can call the functions individually (for example if you want to precache units in a new wave of
  holdout).

  This function should generally only be used if the Precache() function in addon_game_mode.lua is not working.
]]
function barebones:PostLoadPrecache()
	PrecacheManager.PostLoadPrecache()
end

--[[
  This function is called once and only once after all players have loaded into the game, right as the hero selection time begins.
  It can be used to initialize non-hero player state or adjust the hero selection (i.e. force random etc)
]]
function barebones:OnAllPlayersLoaded()
	DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] All Players have loaded into the game.")
end

--[[
  This function is called once and only once when the game completely begins (about 0:00 on the clock).  At this point,
  gold will begin to go up in ticks if configured, creeps will spawn, towers will become damageable etc.  This function
  is useful for starting any game logic timers/thinkers, beginning the first round, etc.
]]
function barebones:OnGameInProgress()
	DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] The game has officially begun.")
	-- If the day/night is not changed at 00:00, the following line is needed:
	GameRules:SetTimeOfDay(0.251)
end

-- This function initializes the game mode and is called before anyone loads into the game
-- It can be used to pre-initialize any values/tables that will be needed later
function barebones:InitGameMode()
	DebugPrint("[BAREBONES] Starting to load Game Rules.")

	-- Setup rules
	GameRules:SetSameHeroSelectionEnabled(ALLOW_SAME_HERO_SELECTION)
	GameRules:SetUseUniversalShopMode(UNIVERSAL_SHOP_MODE)
	GameRules:SetHeroRespawnEnabled(ENABLE_HERO_RESPAWN)

	GameRules:SetHeroSelectPenaltyTime(HERO_SELECTION_PENALTY_TIME)

	GameRules:SetPreGameTime(PRE_GAME_TIME)
	GameRules:SetPostGameTime(POST_GAME_TIME)
	GameRules:SetShowcaseTime(SHOWCASE_TIME)
	GameRules:SetStrategyTime(STRATEGY_TIME)

	GameRules:SetTreeRegrowTime(TREE_REGROW_TIME)

	if USE_CUSTOM_HERO_LEVELS then
		GameRules:SetUseCustomHeroXPValues(true)
	end

	--GameRules:SetGoldTickTime(GOLD_TICK_TIME) -- Doesn't work; Last time tested: 24.2.2020

	if USE_CUSTOM_HERO_GOLD_BOUNTY then

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_knockback_silent.lua
+modifier_knockback_silent = class({})
+
+function modifier_knockback_silent:IsHidden() return true end
+function modifier_knockback_silent:IsPurgable() return false end
+function modifier_knockback_silent:IsDebuff() return true end
+function modifier_knockback_silent:GetAttributes()
+    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_IGNORE_INVULNERABLE
+end
+
+function modifier_knockback_silent:OnCreated(kv)
+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    self.parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+
+    local duration = tonumber(kv and (kv.knockback_duration or kv.duration)) or 0
+    local distance = tonumber(kv and kv.knockback_distance) or 0
+    if duration <= 0 or distance <= 0 then
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+
+    local center = Vector(tonumber(kv.center_x) or 0, tonumber(kv.center_y) or 0, tonumber(kv.center_z) or 0)
+    local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
+    local dir = origin - center
+    dir.z = 0
+    local len = dir:Length2D()
+    if len <= 0.01 then
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+    dir = dir:Normalized()
+
+    self.duration = duration
+    self.distance = distance
+    self.velocity = dir * (distance / duration)
+    self.end_time = GameRules:GetGameTime() + duration
+    self.start_pos = origin
+
+    if self.parent.ApplyHorizontalMotionController and not self.parent:ApplyHorizontalMotionController(self) then
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_knockback_silent:OnDestroy()
+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    if self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
+        self.parent:RemoveHorizontalMotionController(self)
+        FindClearSpaceForUnit(self.parent, self.parent:GetAbsOrigin(), false)
+    end
+end
+
+function modifier_knockback_silent:UpdateHorizontalMotion(me, dt)
+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    if not me or me:IsNull() then
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
+    if now >= (self.end_time or 0) then
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+    local pos = me:GetAbsOrigin()
+    local new_pos = pos + (self.velocity * dt)
+    new_pos.z = pos.z
+    me:SetAbsOrigin(new_pos)
+end
+
+function modifier_knockback_silent:OnHorizontalMotionInterrupted()
+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    self:Destroy()
+end
*** End Patch

payload.message:
实现了“与 Dota2 击退一致的位移效果，但不播放击退动画”的最优方案：用自定义水平运动控制器替代 `modifier_knockback`，保持相同的中心点/距离/持续时间参数，但不会触发引擎击退动画。

改动说明
- 新增 `modifier_knockback_silent`（水平位移 Motion Controller），按 `center_x/y/z + knockback_distance + knockback_duration` 做线性位移，不走引擎击退动画。
- 全部 `modifier_knockback` 调用替换为 `modifier_knockback_silent`。

文件变更
- 新增 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/modifiers/modifier_knockback_silent.lua`
- 更新 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/gamemode.lua`（LinkLuaModifier）
- 更新使用点：
  - `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/abilities/tiny_toss_tree.lua`
  - `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/abilities/crystal_maiden_ice_burst.lua`
  - `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/spawn_wall_manager.lua`

行为要点
- 位移方向与原 `modifier_knockback` 一致（从 center 指向单位当前点）。
- 仅水平位移，Z 不变。
- 不播放击退动画。

如果你希望击退过程中还禁止转身/攻击，或者需要“阻挡穿墙/路径修正”的更严谨逻辑，我可以在这个自定义 modifier 里继续加（如定期 `ResolvePosition`、或临时 `modifier_phased`/`command restricted`）。

@@
 function modifier_knockback_silent:OnCreated(kv)
     if not IsServer() then return end
     self.parent = self:GetParent()
     if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
         self:Destroy()
         return
     end
 
     local duration = tonumber(kv and (kv.knockback_duration or kv.duration)) or 0
     local distance = tonumber(kv and kv.knockback_distance) or 0
     if duration <= 0 or distance <= 0 then
         self:Destroy()
         return
     end
@@
     if len <= 0.01 then
         self:Destroy()
         return
     end
     dir = dir:Normalized()
 
     self.duration = duration
     self.distance = distance
     self.velocity = dir * (distance / duration)
     self.end_time = GameRules:GetGameTime() + duration
     self.start_pos = origin
-
-    if self.parent.ApplyHorizontalMotionController and not self.parent:ApplyHorizontalMotionController(self) then
-        self:Destroy()
-        return
-    end
+    self:StartIntervalThink(FrameTime())
 end
 
 function modifier_knockback_silent:OnDestroy()
     if not IsServer() then return end
     if self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
-        self.parent:RemoveHorizontalMotionController(self)
         FindClearSpaceForUnit(self.parent, self.parent:GetAbsOrigin(), false)
     end
 end
 
-function modifier_knockback_silent:UpdateHorizontalMotion(me, dt)
+function modifier_knockback_silent:OnIntervalThink()
     if not IsServer() then return end
-    if not me or me:IsNull() then
+    local me = self.parent
+    if not me or me:IsNull() then
         self:Destroy()
         return
     end
     local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
     if now >= (self.end_time or 0) then
         self:Destroy()
         return
     end
     local pos = me:GetAbsOrigin()
-    local new_pos = pos + (self.velocity * dt)
+    local new_pos = pos + (self.velocity * FrameTime())
     new_pos.z = pos.z
     me:SetAbsOrigin(new_pos)
 end
 
-function modifier_knockback_silent:OnHorizontalMotionInterrupted()
-    if not IsServer() then return end
-    self:Destroy()
-end
*** End Patch

这里说的“被拒绝”指的是**水平运动控制器**的机制：  
当你调用 `ApplyHorizontalMotionController(self)` 时，如果单位已经有其它水平运动控制器（或引擎判定该单位不能再加一个），这个调用会返回 `false`。这就导致**原先那种写法直接 `Destroy()`，单位完全不动**。

所以我把实现改成**不走 motion controller**，而是用 `StartIntervalThink(FrameTime())` 每帧 `SetAbsOrigin` 推动位置，这样不会被控制器系统拒绝。

如果你想保留 motion controller 方案，也可以在失败时 fallback 到 interval 位移。但目前的实现就是直接绕开“可能被拒绝”的路径。

-    self:StartIntervalThink(FrameTime())
+    if self.parent.ApplyHorizontalMotionController and not self.parent:ApplyHorizontalMotionController(self) then
+        print("[modifier_knockback_silent] ApplyHorizontalMotionController failed", self.parent:GetUnitName())
+        self:Destroy()
+        return
+    end
+    print("[modifier_knockback_silent] MotionController applied",
+        self.parent:GetUnitName(),
+        "duration", self.duration,
+        "distance", self.distance,
+        "vel", tostring(self.velocity))
 end
 
 function modifier_knockback_silent:OnDestroy()
     if not IsServer() then return end
     if self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
+        self.parent:RemoveHorizontalMotionController(self)
         FindClearSpaceForUnit(self.parent, self.parent:GetAbsOrigin(), false)
     end
 end
 
-function modifier_knockback_silent:OnIntervalThink()
+function modifier_knockback_silent:UpdateHorizontalMotion(me, dt)
     if not IsServer() then return end
-    local me = self.parent
-    if not me or me:IsNull() then
+    if not me or me:IsNull() then
         self:Destroy()
         return
     end
     local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
     if now >= (self.end_time or 0) then

 end
+
+function modifier_knockback_silent:OnHorizontalMotionInterrupted()
+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    print("[modifier_knockback_silent] Motion interrupted", self.parent and self.parent:GetUnitName() or "nil")
+    self:Destroy()
+end

@@

     return {
         MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION,
         MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_PRIORITY,
+        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION_RATE,
+        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_TRANSLATE_ACTIVITY_MODIFIERS,
     }
 end
@@
 function modifier_knockback_no_anim:GetOverrideAnimation()
-    return ACT_DOTA_IDLE
+    return ACT_DOTA_RUN
 end

+local function ResetKnockbackGestures(unit)
+    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
+        return
+    end
+    if unit.FadeGesture then

+    end
+end

+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    self.parent = self:GetParent()
+    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then

+        end)

+end
+

+    if not IsServer() then return end
+    if self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() and self.__added_activity and self.parent.RemoveActivityModifier then
+        self.parent:RemoveActivityModifier("run")
+    end
